about_us.text_1: Testimona is a social platform dedicated to the memory of our loved ones who are now in heaven. As they remain in our heart forever, our community celebrates their life and the beautiful memories we shared with them. It is our way to tell their stories to our family and friends, and pass these beautiful testimonials to our children and future generations.
about_us.text_2: While losing someone brings grief, we know how comforting it is to hear and read testimonials from the kind people who cross paths with the ones we care of. Testimona is therefore a place where life is cherished and stories are told in your own words, and we are committed to provide to our community a safe place for remembrance.
about_us.text_3: As you’re visiting this website which was designed for you, you will find a place where you, your family and friends can share memorable souvenirs, tell amusing anecdotes, and write life stories about your loved one. These testimonials will surely bring comfort to you and all the people who once met and knew this one individual you all have in common.
about_us.text_4: Nowadays, we know families and friends may be located in different places, and it may be difficult for some to attend funerals. You may also know a deceased person and have never met with the relatives, but still want to support the grieving family. Testimona allows you to make donations to the immediate family of the deceased. While you may not know them personally, we will carefully deliver donations to the rightful persons. Testimona will verify the identity of the family members, confirm the relationship with the deceased and inform all the generous donors of the recipients before proceeding. It is the safest way to ensure your donations serve its purpose and avoid fraud.
about_us.text_5: We aspire to be the premier social platform for remembering the life of deceased persons where family and friends will post testimonials, write life stories, donate to grieving families and build lasting memories for future generations.
about_us.text_6: Our vision is to celebrate the life of our loved ones in heaven by creating a sharing environment where testimonials and their life stories are written for future generations.
about_us.text_7: The values that we cherish are integrity, transparency, passion and dedication.
